state_meanings.EMERGING: initial bounded evidence; insufficient for stable inference
state_meanings.TENTATIVE: more than an isolated observation but still narrow or uncertain
state_meanings.SEMI_STABLE: repeated across time or bounded contexts with unresolved limits
state_meanings.STABLE_CANDIDATE: diverse evidence supports a durable candidate without truth declaration
state_meanings.REVISING: new evidence or user correction is creating a lineage successor
state_meanings.SUPERSEDED: replaced by a newer candidate while retained for audit
state_meanings.EXPIRED: temporal validity ended without truth promotion
